mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 5-day returns is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that precede stronger corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production in late-cycle expansions signals potential overheating and impending monetary tightening, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when INDPRO is rising, or INDPRO Rank IC in late-cycle is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher real GDP levels (above 16,500 billion dollars) indicate stronger economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above 16,500, or GDPC1 Rank IC on 5-day returns is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 2.5%, or CPIAUCSL Rank IC on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls and industrial production indicates strong labor market and manufacturing expansion, together driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO are rising, or interaction term (PAYEMS * INDPRO) Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts in early-cycle recoveries signal improving consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of early-cycle periods when HOUST is rising, or HOUST Rank IC in early-cycle is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
